name: Markeaton Park Playground
description: Derby's biggest park, run by Derby City Council. The free paddling pool at the Mundy Place Centre opens for the summer (in 2025 it ran 10.30am–4pm daily from late May to early September), and in school holidays the Mundy Play Centre has paid extras such as bouncy castles, electric cars, canoes, mini golf and fairground rides. The Orangery Café is in the park.
